The roaring cheers are coming over the loudspeakers\nset everywhere in the square...
N-No... The Empress isn't here...\nNot even the people...
What are they going to do with such a big empty\nplace...
It's ridiculous and crazy but now I'm sure...\nIt's a trap to lure us out! Everyone retreat now!\nHurry!!
I-Is she the Empress of Lyark...?\nGosh, she's literally a little girl...
People of Ultimea!\nI'm grateful to your efforts to build this venue...
What?! Hey! She began her speech!\nWhat are the partisans doing?!
...As a reward for all your efforts, instead of\na boring speech from me, today I'll give you an\ninteresting show.
It's dangerous to watch near the venue, so enjoy\nthe live from our broadcasting team at your home!!
Dammit, retreat!\nNino! Pasca! You guys go now and...
E-Everyone... Retreat...\nYou guys must survive...\nD-Do you understood...?
Nino... Don't...\nIt can't be true... right?
...Now you are the only partisan left...
I think it's when I got hit just before the last\nbattle... What a shame...
What the hell are you doing, idiot?!\nYour captain Romfh... told you guys to survive!!
Who's gonna follow his order if you were all gone?!
...You guys are still alive, huh?\nAnd a backup is coming right?\nPlease tell them...
The partisans in Hora Diomedea were fighting\nagainst the Lyark from underground for a long\nand...
They were all brave... until the...\nvery last minute...
Stop it! Nobody would praise you if you died!!
You can't become a legendary partisan in front\nof me!!
What are you standing here for?!\nWe retreat now. Help me carry him!
